claims: "Golden" from the animated film KPop Demon Hunters won Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
"Golden" is the first K-pop track to win Best Original Song at the Academy Awards.
"Golden" was written by Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo, Teddy Park, and Ejae.
"Golden" was performed live by Rei Ami, EJAE, and Audrey Nuna.
"Golden" is the first K-pop song to win Best Original Song.
"Golden" is the first song with more than four writers to win Best Original Song.
"Dear Me" from Diane Warren: Relentless (Diane Warren) was nominated for 2026 Oscar Best Original Song.
"I Lied to You" from Sinners (Raphael Saadiq and Ludwig Göransson) was nominated for 2026 Oscar Best Original Song.
"Train Dreams" from Train Dreams (Nick Cave and Bryce Dessner) was nominated for 2026 Oscar Best Original Song.
"Sweet Dreams of Joy" from Viva Verdi! (Nicholas Pike) was nominated for 2026 Oscar Best Original Song.
KPop Demon Hunters secured the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
